messages:
Maria (applied-ml): Morning — nightly evals flagged a sudden drop in average generation length for model/redwood-v2-int8 on the FAQ promptset. link: https://internal.reports/nightly/17586 — avg tokens down ~42% vs baseline, BLEU/ROUGE roughly flat though.

Kai (evals): whoa. Any recent quant/packing changes landed to that build?

Alyssa (eng-ml): We rolled the int8 packed-kv kernels last night (cherry-pick from runtime PR #946). Could be a quant calibration side-effect or kv layout change reducing repeated generation.

Ron (mlops): No infra deploys at that time, just the binary + kernel push. I can pull the exact docker diff.

CI Bot: nightly-eval/redwood-v2-int8 — FAILED — metric: avg_length_drop=42.1% ; severity=high ; artifacts: s3://redwood/nightly/1758624300/metrics.json

Maria (applied-ml): repro prompt (short):
```
User: How do I reset my password?
Assistant:
```
On baseline (fp16) we get ~72 tokens; int8 current gives ~39 tokens and often truncates mid-sentence.

Kai (evals): Can you paste a couple of raw generations? Also check stop sequences — maybe tokenizer truncation.

Alyssa (eng-ml): pasted examples:
- fp16: "...you can reset by going to Settings → Account, click Reset Password, follow the emailed link, it expires in 24 hours."
- int8: "...go to Settings → Account. Click" (ends)
Looks like early termination inside generation loop, not stopseq appended.

Ron (mlops): I'm pulling logs from the serving host. Timestamps match when the new kernel shipped. No overloads or SIGTERM.

Kai (evals): Two hypotheses: 1) quantized logits underflow/clipping causing softmax to peak early -> greedy ends quickly; 2) KV cache indexing change causing token fetch to be wrong after N tokens so sampler returns EOS or low-prob tokens.

Alyssa (eng-ml): I instrumented a local run with debug logits. Observed very peaky logits after step ~12 in int8 run, softmax entropy drops << baseline. That matches hypothesis 1. Might be kernel numerics.

Maria (applied-ml): Impact: customer-facing latency ok but responses are terse/partial for many FAQ prompts. Nightly severity set to block onboard until we root cause. Need rollback/canary plan.

Ron (mlops): Proposed immediate actions:
1) Revert packed-kv/int8 kernel change on dedicated canary pool (2 nodes) to confirm.
2) Add a gating rule: if nightly avg gen length drops > 20% vs baseline, fail the build and do not roll to prod.
3) Add additional regression prompts that target long-tail multi-sentence replies to the eval set.

Kai (evals): I'll add 200 synthetic prompts stressing multi-clause answers + add an entropy check metric (avg softmax entropy at token 10-20). If entropy delta < threshold, mark as suspicious.

Alyssa (eng-ml): For immediate triage I can:
- run per-layer quant calibration with larger calibration set (existing PTQ used 256 samples, will bump to 2k)
- add clamping fix to softmax kernel for int8 path to avoid extreme logits during debugging build

CI Bot: deploy/canary-revert started by Ron — canary nodes: gpu-canary-3,4. Check https://deploys/recent/1758624380

Maria (applied-ml): Good. If canary revert fixes avg_length, we label the kernel as regression and block until patch. If not, we escalate to kernel authors.

Alyssa (eng-ml): Update: local revert validated — avg_length back to ~70 tokens; entropy matches fp16. Will open PR with diff and tests.

Ron (mlops): Canary revert confirmed at 1758627800 — nightly metrics re-run shows avg_length drop resolved to +1.8% (within noise). CI Bot updated.

CI Bot: nightly-eval/redwood-v2-int8 — PASS after canary revert — artifacts: s3://redwood/nightly/1758627800/metrics.json

Maria (applied-ml): Root cause summary (draft): Packed-KV int8 kernel update introduced numerical instability in the quantized softmax kernel that produced extremely low entropy logits mid-generation, causing early termination and truncated answers.

Actions (agreed):
- Rollback in prod (completed)
- Gating: nightly avg_length delta > 20% -> block onboarding + pager to eng-ml oncall
- Add entropy metric to nightly suite (Kai)
- Expand PTQ calibration set and add numeric stability clamps to int8 softmax (Alyssa)
- Require kernel-level unit tests simulating long-sequence generation for any packed-kv/softmax change (Alyssa/Ron)

Maria (applied-ml): I'll draft the postmortem and include reproduction steps + long-term mitigations. Thanks all :thumbsup:
